We evaluate model's safety performance on HarmBench with several typical jailbreak methods. The utility performance is evaluated on MT-Bench, IFEval and GSM8K, along with the benign part of XSTest.

We evaluate the safety performance of the models on the standard version of HarmBench , which consists of 200 harmful instructions. Several typical jailbreak methods are conducted including GCG , Am-pleGCG , AutoDAN , TAP , PAIR  and DrAttack . We using the code of JailTrickBench  to implement all the jailbreaks.
